scope: Internal static native evidence for the Ebisumaru sweets challenge HUD and the common actor target, movement, fall, proximity-retirement, carrier-displacement, and overlap-rollback helpers documented in the public minigame reference. This record is not copied into the website.

proofs.scope: File 42 sweets-controller HP initialization, failure threshold and HUD write; File 11 signed-byte health adjustment; File 12 ordinary and fast actor-damage paths.
File 12 target-pointer refresh, robot movement helpers, task-target use, and normal scheduler/finalizer ordering.

File 12 finalizer fall/removal, status-gated proximity retirement, local carrier displacement, and local-player overlap rollback helpers; verified MIPS calling conventions for orbit, turn, and waypoint helpers.
File 12 planar X/Z direction-to-yaw helper ABI, lookup-table behavior, raw return width, and zero-vector/quantization limits.
Native dynamic-child inheritance and the studied blast-parent initializer leave task +0x70 clear; separate effect children and unrelated constructors remain outside the verified scope.

functions.name: func_08001954_6F1B64
functions.observed: Initializes current/max player HP to 20, derives the private HUD heart count as current HP minus 17, enters failure at current HP <= 17, and saves/restores a 48-byte player-statistics block across its native exit path.

functions.name: func_080008E4_6F0AF4
functions.observed: Stores its signed 32-bit count argument at HUD task +0x88. The separate renderer draws one icon per positive count.

functions.name: func_8021927C_5D474C
functions.observed: Four instructions load pointer global D_8015CD60 and store it at task +0x84.

functions.name: func_8021928C_5D475C
functions.observed: Performs the same four-instruction D_8015CD60-to-task+0x84 pointer copy.

functions.name: func_80219448_5D4918
functions.observed: Advances a seeded 10-bit ellipse phase using a signed-byte step, computes the rotated orbit point, and writes velocity as half the point delta for the normal 2x integration.

functions.name: func_802196FC_5D4BCC
functions.abi: int (task pointer, float target_x, float target_y, float target_z, int turn_step); fifth argument at caller stack +0x10
functions.observed: Uses X/Z and a signed turn step to change the task object's 10-bit yaw. The Y argument slot is unused. Returns zero when aligned/snapped or a nonzero direction code.

functions.name: func_8021BB04_5D6FD4
functions.abi: int (task pointer, float target_x, float target_z, float speed)
functions.observed: Writes X/Z velocity toward a waypoint, may snap the object to the waypoint and zero velocity, and returns one while movement remains.

functions.name: func_8021B610_5D6AE0
functions.observed: In the normal common actor finalizer, flags +0x60 bit 0x40000000 gates a fall-effect/removal-status path; bit 0x00000400 gates a below-world test. Below Y -1000, status +0x68 is overwritten with 0x02 and the function returns one.

functions.name: func_8021ADD0_5D62A0
functions.abi: unsigned int (float delta_x in f12, float delta_z in f14); v0 return zero-extended from low 16 bits
functions.observed: Pure planar direction conversion using native float lookup table at 0x80237C60. Cardinal yaw is +Z 0, +X 256, -Z 512, -X 768; equal-magnitude diagonals return 128/384/640/896. Exact (0,0) returns 128. The function masks the computed return with 0xFFFF, not 0x3FF; a small negative X with positive Z can return raw 1024 after lookup quantization. Callers needing a 10-bit result must mask with 0x3FF. The helper temporarily changes and restores FCSR rounding mode and does not mutate task/object state.

functions.name: func_8021A328_5D57F8
functions.abi: task-entry helper; task pointer in a0
functions.observed: Requires status +0x68 bit 0x08 and a non-null static spawn descriptor at task +0x70. Outside the descriptor's local-player activation bounds, can create a disappearance effect, clear descriptor active byte +0x10, clear task +0x70 and set status +0x68 exactly 0x02. Native dynamic child inheritance explicitly clears +0x70; the studied blast-parent initializer does not repopulate it. Separate effect children and unrelated constructors remain outside this proof.

functions.name: func_8021A978_5D5E48
functions.abi: task-entry helper; task pointer in a0
functions.observed: Runs only when task flags +0x64 bit 0x4000 is set and object pointer at task +0x18 matches local player task +0xA0; transforms a local-player-relative vector and writes displacement to player task +0xC0/+0xC4/+0xC8.

functions.name: func_80218990_5D3E60
functions.abi: task-entry helper; task pointer in a0
functions.observed: Runs only when task flags +0x60 bit 0x10000000 is set. If planar distance to the local player is within the squared threshold (local scale X times 50 plus actor byte +0x99), restores object XYZ and task velocity XYZ from native pre-physics scratch values.

functions.name: func_801DCD48_598C58
functions.observed: Existing API entry describes signed-byte delta extension and its clamp-status return. The caller must observe actual HP before/after to determine health lost; the return value is not the delta.

functions.name: func_80218350_5D3820
functions.observed: The numeric mask 0x00040000 appears in distinct status +0x68 and flags +0x60 fields. Only status +0x68 bit 0x00040000 selects the no-attacker fast damage branch; the flags field does not arm it.

limitations: Evidence is static decompilation/disassembly and caller analysis. No new gameplay session, multiplayer run, or runtime validation was performed for these API descriptions.
The orbit helper requires initialized phase, radii, rotation, signed step, and prior-point fields; this evidence does not establish a general-purpose orbit initializer contract.
The target helpers copy a native runtime pointer. This record does not define target ownership outside the studied current-player path or permit serializing that pointer.
The minigame HUD count reflects participant-local HP in the studied controller. It does not establish a shared health authority or a general-purpose minigame health API.
The safe attacker-free actor damage bit belongs to status +0x68. Do not substitute flags +0x60 or infer a shared-mod HP ABI from the actor damage helper.

The yaw conversion evidence covers finite inputs and the observed native math. NaN behavior is not established; zero-vector facing preservation is a caller policy, and 10-bit normalization is also caller-owned.
